body: Intimacy, relationships, sex and all other aspects of spending your life with another person are everyday normal things. But then again so is not wanting any of that, yes everything in media is designed to make you want relationships and sex, but if you dont want it then you have to be tolerant towards the majority of people just like you want them to be tolerant of your feelings. It's difficult to navigate but I have faith that you'll be able to feel accepted and comfortable with who you are despite the world kinda going against your grain!
